title: Elixir of Necrotic Resistance

sources.title: Elixir of Necrotic Resistance
markers: Grants resistance to necrotic damage that last until a long rest.

sources.title: Elixirs
markers: Only one elixir can be applied at a time

summary: Drink as a Bonus Action. Gain resistance to Necrotic damage until the next Long Rest.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Gain resistance to Necrotic damage until the next Long Rest.
fields.Stacking: Replaces another elixir effect. Drinking a different elixir can end this effect early.
fields.Creative use: Drink before a fight where this effect will matter.
fields.Crafting: Combine Vitriol of Oleander with any Sublimate.
fields.Base value: 25 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 activation, effects and linked rules.
